tools.name: govdelivery_list_topics
tools.description: List the topics of the GovDelivery account (their codes and names). Topic codes are needed for subscriptions and bulletins. Read-only. GovDelivery REST: GET /api/account/{account}/topics.

tools.name: govdelivery_get_subscriber
tools.description: Read one subscriber by email address: their topic subscriptions and record fields, as GovDelivery returns them (XML). Read-only. GovDelivery REST: GET /api/account/{account}/subscribers/{base64 email}.xml.

tools.name: govdelivery_get_bulletin
tools.description: Read one bulletin by id: subject, state (draft or sent), topics and total subscribers, as GovDelivery returns them (XML). Read-only. Bulletin ids come from the bulletin you created or from GovDelivery. GovDelivery REST: GET /api/account/{account}/bulletins/{id}.xml.

tools.name: govdelivery_set_subscriber_topics
tools.description: WRITE: adds ONE subscriber to topics, or REPLACES that subscriber's topic subscriptions with exactly the codes given (GovDelivery 'replace or create'), so topics not listed may be removed. Use only for a person who opted in to these topics; never for purchased or scraped lists. Set send_notification

tools.name: govdelivery_create_bulletin_draft
tools.description: WRITE: creates a DRAFT bulletin for the given topics. Nothing is sent: the draft waits in GovDelivery until govdelivery_send_bulletin sends it. Subject: plain text, max 400 characters; GovDelivery advises against special characters such as ! or quotes because spam filters may flag them (advice only,

tools.name: govdelivery_send_bulletin
tools.description: WRITE: SENDS an existing DRAFT bulletin by email to every subscriber of its topics, now. This cannot be undone. Set confirm_send to true only after the user has approved this exact bulletin in this conversation. A sent bulletin cannot be sent again. GovDelivery REST: POST /api/account/{account}/bull

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: govdelivery_get_subscriber, govdelivery_set_subscriber_topics, govdelivery_create_bulletin_draft · Private data: govdelivery_get_subscriber · Public sink: govdelivery_get_subscriber, govdelivery_set_subscriber_topics, govdelivery_create_bulletin_draft, govdelivery_send_bulletin.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: govdelivery_get_subscriber, govdelivery_set_subscriber_topics, govdelivery_create_bulletin_draft · Private data: govdelivery_get_subscriber · Public sink: govdelivery_get_subscriber, govdelivery_set_subscriber_topics, govdelivery_create_bulletin_draft, govdelivery_send_bulletin

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
